label: Trailer Cinematográfico (45s) · Destino Solar (Sci‑Fi Adventure)
description: Trailer de ficção científica de 45 s, mostrando uma nave espacial rumo a uma estrela distante, com luzes de hiperespaço e planetas exóticos.
resources: sound design de motores de foguete

scenes.prompt: Wide shot of a sleek starship departing a neon-lit spaceport, 85mm cinema lens, no speech, on-screen text: PARTIDA.
Close‑up of the ship’s engine igniting, plasma trails, slow motion, no speech, on-screen text: IMPULSO.
Ship cruising through a field of shimmering asteroids, golden dust, no speech, on-screen text: O CÉU.
Approach to a massive bright sun, heat distortion, ship’s hull reflecting, no speech, on-screen text: DESTINO.
Final silhouette of the ship against the solar flare, title reveal, no speech, on-screen text: NOVO HORIZONTE.

narration.text: A jornada rumo ao sol desafia o impossível, cada luz reflete nossa ousadia.
